# RuForge

> RuForge is a free open-source desktop media library and yt-dlp frontend for Windows. Built with Tauri v2 and Rust, it downloads videos and audio from yt-dlp's 1000+ supported sites, stores them in a local library, and includes a full media player with chapter navigation, SponsorBlock integration, and a mini player. MIT licensed. No ads, no telemetry, no premium tier.

RuForge uses yt-dlp as the download engine and FFmpeg for media processing. It ships as a signed Windows installer with an auto-updater. Linux is supported for local development; macOS is not yet supported as a release target.

## Feature pages

- [Downloader](https://ruforge.app/features/downloader): Persistent download queue, playlists, audio-only mode
- [Media library](https://ruforge.app/features/media-library): Local gallery with auto-scan and search
- [Player](https://ruforge.app/features/player): Video and audio playback with chapter navigation
- [SponsorBlock](https://ruforge.app/features/sponsorblock): Automatic sponsor segment skip on downloaded files
- [Mini player](https://ruforge.app/features/mini-player): Compact floating player window
- [Settings](https://ruforge.app/features/settings): Downloads, library paths, player behavior
